purpose: Name the frame-phase actor allocator block and its zero-type moving-child template.

code_block.name: Actor_SpawnFramePhaseChild
code_block.incoming_edges: No static incoming edge was recovered by the current whole-ROM export.

behavior.position: Copies source actor X/Y words from A2 offsets +0x02/+0x04 into the allocated actor.
behavior.phase_selection: Masks FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER at 0x00FF7E28 to its low two bits, indexes a phase table at A6+0x49A9, and copies the selected type byte and animation longword into the new actor.
behavior.velocity: Sets actor vertical velocity to -0x0400 and horizontal velocity to +0x0200 or -0x0200 according to PLAYER_WORLD_X relative to the copied actor X.
behavior.facing: Sets actor facing byte 0xFF when FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER bit 3 is set.
